Name: Seasonal Witchy-Gothic Buildings
Author: naeldeus
Description:
a good while ago, i started making the witchy buildings seasonal after they were brought up in the sdv discord. i took some liberties due to lack of assets. ali was cool with it, so here they are! enjoy! 

[center][color=#ffffff][url=https://ko-fi.com/naeldeus]consider buying me a coffee if you enjoy my mods and wish to support me![/url]﻿[/color][/center]

[b]features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]a seasonal update and content packer version for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/420]witchy-gothic buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]ali[/url]﻿
[*]you can choose between ali's original shed and a new alternative design
[*]there are no added buildings beyond a new shed 
[/list]

[b]installation:
[/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*]that’s it, enjoy!
[/list]

[b]credits:[/b]

[list]
[*]ali for her original buildings
[/list]
